name: Introspection
bootlegger: Demons and Minions don't know eachother. When a Minion dies, it learns who the Demon is, and the demon learns this minion.
The demon doesn't receive any bluff.
If Riot is in play, Minions and demon learn eachother on night 3. When Riot happens, players learn their character immediately instead of during the following night.
Virgin is drunk when riot happens
